Players Committee card image of [[Commander Wedge Antilles (V) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting Rogue 3, it is maneuver +2 and your Force drains here are +1. While piloting a T-47, Wedge draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise and, if opponent draws more than one battle destiny here, may cancel one.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/commanderwedgeantilles.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/53572eb94d14c4f21f0f3396874727653397c6e8 53572eb] (16 August 2023). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the latest version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
